records.name: Gronnlings Abound
records.description: Gronnlings are a menace to the region.  We should partner with the Frostwolf clan to thin the population.  One may even join our cause...

records.name: Landfall Recovery
records.description: It would be a worthwhile endeavor to search the ship we escaped Tanaan Jungle in, it's bound to turn up something useful!

records.name: Powdered Gronnling
records.description: Gronnling bones have been discovered in the cavern behind the garrison. Your alchemists are interested in digging them up for research purposes.

records.name: Grimfrost Wolfbeaters
records.description: The Grimfrost Ogres east of the Icewind Drifts are blatantly mistreating frostwolves.  Unacceptable!

records.name: Stonefury Rescue
records.description: There are reports of a bloody massacre on the Stonefury Cliffs!  Scatter the Frostbeak Scavengers and rescue wounded allies!

records.name: Frosty Potions
records.description: A scout has located a cache of Thunderlord potions frozen in the snow. Recovering them will allow your alchemists to learn about the ingredients of Draenor.

records.name: Gimme Loots
records.description: Grab all the loots

records.name: Frostfire Patrol
records.description: This is Matt's test mission *bugles and horns blair a triumphant tune*

records.name: Skyward Threat
records.description: Rylaks from the Burning Glacier have been attacking our supply caravans.  The material must flow!

records.name: Ogre Remedies
records.description: Bladespire ogres on the Burning Glacier usually carry packs of supplies when they venture out into the dunes of Frostfire. They may contain new types of potions.

records.name: No Loots For You
records.description: Run away!!

records.name: Orcs in the Mountains!
records.description: Kill the orcs in the mountains.

records.name: Ogres in the Desert!
records.description: Kill the ogres in the desert.

records.name: Undead In The Snow
records.description: Kill the undead in the snow.

records.name: Arakkoa Underground
records.description: Kill the arakkoa underground.

records.name: Beasts in the Jungle
records.description: Kill the beasts in the jungle.

records.name: Demons in the Forest
records.description: Kill the demons in the forest.

records.name: Breakers in Town
records.description: Kill the breakers in the town.

records.name: Furies in the Swamp
records.description: Kill the furies in the swamp.

records.name: Primals in the Plains
records.description: Kill the primals in the plains.

records.name: One Mission To Rule Them All
records.description: The sword of a thousand truths must be destroyed in the Blackrock Foundry.  Make it happen dawg.

records.name: The Night Watch
records.description: A regular patrol around the garrison seems like a good idea...

records.name: Killing the Corrupted
records.description: Corrupted beasts continue to plague the Cursed Woods. The Starfall Sentinels request our aid in putting the poor creatures out of their misery.

records.name: Thunderlord Assault
records.description: We could send several of our best on a raid of the Thunderlord outpost of Colossal's Fall!  Go forth to victory.

records.name: Clean the Latrine
records.description: It's best not to lose a bet with the janitor.

records.name: Landfall Recovery
records.description: It would be a worthwhile endeavor to search the ship we escaped Tanaan Jungle in, it's bound to turn up something useful!

records.name: The Night Watch
records.description: A regular patrol around the garrison seems like a good idea...

records.name: Skyward Threat
records.description: Lunarfall Ravens from Moonflower Valley have been attacking our supply caravans.  The material must flow!

records.name: Shadowmoon Assault
records.description: We could send several of our best on a raid of the Shadowmoon outpost of Shaz'Gul!  For the Alliance!

records.name: Fey Friends
records.description: Arcane Anomalies are endangering the Fey Dragons of the Shimmer Mor.  Unacceptable!

records.name: Rangari Rescue
records.description: The Shadowmoon have taken several Rangari and Alliance forces captive.  Infiltrate and rescue!

records.name: Savage Kindred
records.description: The gronn and the ogres are working together on a two-pronged attack. We must disrupt their machinations before they overwhelm us.

records.name: Industrial Espionage
records.description: If there are design flaws in the Blackrock clan's war machines, we can disable them. Break in and inspect the war machines for weaknesses.

records.name: Claws, Pincers, AND Tusks
records.description: Draenor can count the genesaur among its most vicious creatures. We must contain them before they spread from Gorgrond to other areas.

records.name: Birds of Pray
records.description: We would like to leave the vicious arakkoa alone, but capturing their temple in the Spires of Arak would give us a strategic advantage.

records.name: Talador Burning
records.description: Abyssals, the minions of Sargeras, are roaming the forests of Talador, setting them ablaze. Destroy them before the forest is ash.

records.name: Into the Saberon's Den
records.description: Many of the rescued draenei prisoners have gone missing, and we think the saberon are to blame. Go investigate, but go well armed.

records.name: Burning Legion Vanguard
records.description: With infernals and felguard invading Talador, the rest of the Burning Legion can't be far behind. Defeat them, and try to find their source.

records.name: Twisting the Nether
records.description: The voidlords and voidcallers plaguing Shadowmoon Valley are being summoned by someone. Find and kill whoever is responsible.

records.name: Hardened Creatures
records.description: Magnaron and goren both grow rocky plates on their hides that have magical properties. Collect these plates for our use.

records.name: Iron Horde Allies
records.description: Numerous and powerful, ogre warlords are formidable allies of the Iron Horde. Try to induce them to leave - forcefully, if necessary.

records.name: Clefthoof Rustling
records.description: To weaken the Thunderlord clan, we must eliminate their fiercest warriors - their clefthoof-riders. Go to their camp and free their mounts.

records.name: The Corruption Spreads
records.description: Fel magic has corrupted a few ancients of Shadowmoon Valley. They must be cut down to end their mad rampages.

records.name: Heart of the Iron Horde
records.description: The Warsong clan is a symbol of the Iron Horde's power. Under the cover of night, set its camp ablaze. This will kill their morale.

records.name: Saberon Ambush
records.description: Patrols have reported that roving bands of saberon are waylaying merchants traveling through Nagrand. Find them and stop them.

records.name: The Feathers Must Fly
records.description: Arakkoa talonpriests have begun sacrificing draenei to their god, Terokk. Interrupt their ritual and free the prisoners.

records.name: Cult of Sargeras
records.description: In a remote corner of Talador, a small faction of draenei has embraced the worship of Sargeras. Stop their cult before it spreads.

records.name: To Freedom!
records.description: Ogre slavers have captured many of the draenei displaced by the Iron Horde. Send someone to their camp and liberate them.

records.name: Go for the Heads
records.description: Without their leader, the high ogre attack our spies warned us about will fail. Send an assassin to kill their warlord in Nagrand.

records.name: Secrets of Blademoon
records.description: The hardened bark of the genesaur and botani offer an opportunity to strengthen our armor.  Do what needs to be done.

records.name: Ravager Infestation
records.description: Pests! These ravagers are everywhere - in our supplies, in our barracks! Eradicate their nest in the Spires of Arak before they overrun us.

records.name: The Infernals' Fury
records.description: Infernals are an uncommon sight in Talador. We'd like to keep it that way. The more that are destroyed, the better.

records.name: The Basilisk's Stare
records.description: Basilisks have turned some arakkoa in the Spires of Arak to stone. It's macabre, but this stone is a precious resource. Gather it carefully.

records.name: Elemental Territory
records.description: A group of territorial elementals has claimed an area near our supply route in Frostfire Ridge. Slay them and collect any lost supplies.

records.name: Flora and Fauna
records.description: Dark magic runs amok in Shadowmoon Valley, giving rise to maddened, unnatural creatures. End their suffering.

records.name: Sorcery, Meet Sword
records.description: Shadowmoon spellcasters are experimenting with unstable void magic near the Teluuna Observatory. Because that's going to end well.

records.name: Weed Whacker
records.description: Don't be fooled. They're only adorable until they swarm you and gnaw your face off.

records.name: A Bit Nippy
records.description: Lately the plains have been even more bitterly cold than usual. Find out what's causing this weather before it starts costing lives.

records.name: Frosty and Delicious
records.description: Elementals are plentiful in Frostfire Ridge. Goren love eating them, and whatever the goren eat, they inherit its powers. Not good.

records.name: Lord of War
records.description: The Bloodmaul ogres have begun raiding Horde outposts, costing us soldiers and supplies. We believe a new warlord is to blame.

records.name: Ancient Anguish
records.description: It's time to chop down a few ancient trees. Only the ones that are demonically corrupted, mind you. The rest, you can hug if you like.

records.name: No Dwarf Left Behind
records.description: Shadowmoon forces have abducted a Wildhammer shaman near the Cursed Woods. Rescue our foolhardy ally and bring the orcs to justice.

records.name: The Howling Void
records.description: We have reports of the Shadowmoon prowling Gloomshade Grove, shrouding the land in foul magic. Disrupt their dark rituals at any cost.

records.name: Silence the Thunder
records.description: Thunderlord hunting parties have been sighted to the north. Set an ambush in the cliffs and show them what the real Horde is made of!

records.name: The Shadow Beneath Us
records.description: The Shadow Council has wormed its way into a network of caves west of the garrison. We cannot allow it to gain a foothold in the region!

records.name: Rylak Attrition
records.description: Killing full-grown rylaks has not diminished their numbers in the least. Scour their nesting grounds and end this menace at the source.

records.name: Ancient Affliction
records.description: A strange disease is spreading among Gorgrond's ancients, driving them mad. Destroy them before the infection escalates.

records.name: Breaking the Blackrock
records.description: Scouts have recovered a map of Blackrock supply caches hidden across Gorgrond. Destroying them would strike a grave blow to our enemy.

records.name: Ravenous Genesaur
records.description: The Gorgrond genesaur have overhunted in their territory and are raiding nearby draenei camps for food. Attack them and lure them away.

records.name: Little Biters
records.description: A group of goren has settled in a valuable quarry nearby. We need to get them out if we plan to use the quarry in the future.

records.name: Nuisance Gronnling
records.description: Gronnlings continue to interrupt our efforts to expand into Gorgrond. We need to thin their numbers if we wish to gain a foothold.

records.name: Safer Up Close
records.description: Iron Horde siege weapons are deadly at a distance but vulnerable up close. Targeting their armaments with a small force may prove wise.

records.name: Shivan Sightings
records.description: Shivan have been sighted on the outskirts of Talador. They may be the first wave of a Burning Legion incursion. Investigation is warranted.

records.name: Stalactite Appetite
records.description: A cavern beneath an inhabited section of Talador has become unstable due to the appetite of the goren inside. We must protect those above.

records.name: Leading the Flock
records.description: A charismatic high arakkoa priest is inciting his congregation to raid nearby settlements in the name of Terokk. We must defend our allies.

records.name: A Call to Action
records.description: Absolute power corrupts, and that's absolutely the reason we must neutralize this powerful warlock. Terminate with extreme prejudice.

records.name: Bully-Free Zone
records.description: From Azeroth to Draenor, bullies and their cronies remain the same. Please show our new "friends" how we deal with their kind on Azeroth.

records.name: There Can Be Only One
records.description: The ogron are said to be violence incarnate, but I've heard your allies are called the same. Let's find out who lives up to their hype.

records.name: Hurts So Good
records.description: Shattered Hand orcs embrace pain, for they say it strengthens them. Make them very strong. Then very dead.

records.name: Crush the Pale
records.description: The Pale are twisted, cowardly wretches, but even scavengers can be deadly in sufficient numbers. Still, that's easily solved, isn't it?

records.name: Bug Squashing
records.description: Ravagers reproduce quickly and eat anything. Like crickets. They're also homicidal and roughly the size of horses. Not like crickets.

records.name: Ryled Up
records.description: Our livestock have gone missing. Tracks point to the rylaks. Deal with the threat, but don't take them lightly.

records.name: Blow by Blow
records.description: A vicious wind serpent appears to be acting on orders from an unseen master, wearing down our defenses. Seek out and end this threat.

records.name: Underhanded
records.description: Our informants in the Shattered Hand have turned out to be double agents. Set up a covert meeting and eliminate them.

records.name: Surge Protection
records.description: Energy-siphoning water spirits are giving our spellcasters fits. Time to bring in reinforcements.

records.name: Spell Check
records.description: The cause of our recent communal lethargy has been traced to Highmaul sorcerers. Find them and put an end to their sinister arcane rites.

records.name: Warsong Swan Song
records.description: Warsong shaman have enacted a spell to open an abyss beneath our feet! Kill all of them before the sands in the hourglass run out!

records.name: Ogre-Kill
records.description: High ogre warriors are in battle array, screaming that they're going to "destroy the interlopers." Do you think they're talking about us?

records.name: Burning Desire
records.description: Burning Blade orcs are attacking treasure hunters at Oshu'gun and looting their crystals. Could they be preparing for some dark ritual?

records.name: Gronn with the Wind
records.description: Our scouts have vanished without a trace! They were last seen entering gronn lands. Find out what happened to them.

records.name: Restless Spirits
records.description: Shadowmoon Valley is haunted by orc spirits that lash out in confusion and rage. Until they are put to rest, no one is safe.

records.name: The Observer Effect
records.description: The Thunderlord orcs are growing bold: their scouts follow Horde parties with little stealth or fear. Such arrogance deserves a response.

records.name: Podling Patrol
records.description: Wayward podlings have stolen a crate of our giant growth elixirs. Recover the potions before the creatures consume them and run amok.

records.name: Blackrock Intelligence
records.description: Blackrock messengers have been spotted crisscrossing the region. Any missives they are carrying could prove invaluable to our cause.

records.name: Break Their Chains
records.description: Ogre slavers are carrying off our allies to fight in their arenas. Pose as a would-be gladiator and free the unwilling combatants.

records.name: Ogron's Out of the Bag
records.description: We know the ogron are going to attack soon because they told us. No one ever said they were smart. Stop them before they do any real harm.

records.name: All That Glitters
records.description: Redistributing wealth from the departed isn't stealing. Trouble is, there's a mighty arakkoan sorcerer who doesn't know it. Do let him know.

records.name: Shreddercide
records.description: The Iron Horde's shredders are laying waste to Talador's forests. Bastards. If someone's doing that, it should be our forces.

records.name: Worth Its Weight
records.description: The arakkoa have begun stealing and hoarding gold. Time to steal it back.

records.name: Curiosity Killed Them
records.description: Saberon have begun attacking with wild abandon. They believe they have nine lives. Prove them wrong.

records.name: Medical Necessity
records.description: Our soldiers in the field need medical supplies, but Warsong orcs are patrolling the road. Escort the caravan so it makes its destination.

records.name: Raider Danger
records.description: Warsong orcs have razed our camp to the north, and the lone survivor says they're headed this way. We must repel the invaders!

records.name: Hazardous Herbivores
records.description: Hippos are taking over the Verdant Mire. They're violently territorial and extremely tough. They're also blocking key resources.

records.name: Cleave the Clefthoof
records.description: In this harsh environment, sturdy transportation is essential. Cripple the Iron Horde by taking out its greatest beasts of burden.

records.name: Toxic Bloom
records.description: A noxious mist is pervading Blademoon Bloom. Find and neutralize the source so that our forces can pass safely through the region.

records.name: The Pale Dilemma
records.description: The pale have stolen a shipment of Iron Horde weaponry. Recover the armaments - by force if necessary - before our enemy does.

records.name: Many-Headed Menace
records.description: Habitat changes in Gorgrond have forced hydras to encroach on draenei settlements. It is a pity, but we must kill these desperate beasts.

records.name: Great Migration
records.description: Every year, great herds of clefthoof migrate through Gorgrond, causing tremors and dust storms. We must divert them from our camp.

records.name: The Needs of the Many
records.description: Elementals are chaotic by nature and are best avoided. This elemental has something we need: resources. Make it an offer it cannot refuse.

records.name: Uproot the Problem
records.description: Our garrison requires resources, so it's harvest time. Kindly remind this savage plant and its minions why we're atop the food chain.

records.name: Knotty by Nature
records.description: An ancient has begun attacking everyone and everything in its path. On a related note, we're currently low on firewood.

records.name: Nevermore
records.description: We think the recent dread raven attacks are connected to the arakkoa. We'll investigate them. You hunt down and kill their minions.

records.name: Mercy Killing
records.description: War has ravaged the region's plant life, and the clefthoof don't have enough to eat. We should thin out their numbers before they starve.

records.name: Out of His Element
records.description: Enraged, Stonegar has begun attacking shaman near the Throne of the Elements. We must send forces to aid.

records.name: The Best-Laid Plans...
records.description: Our former courier got spooked and dropped an important package from Karabor in a thicket of botani and ancients.  Retrieve the package!

records.name: Free Labor
records.description: Bladespire ogres have captured a band of laborers from the garrison. Infiltrate their fortress and free the workers.

records.name: Dumb and Dumber
records.description: Several gronn and ogron came here to attack us, but the dumb beasts are just fighting each other. Let's kill them all and end this farce.

records.name: Guinea Pigs
records.description: Blackrock orcs are testing out their war machines on the region's unsuspecting fauna. This aggression will not stand!

records.name: The Plot Thickens
records.description: Demons have been skulking about the Court of Souls, and it's not because they enjoy the scenery. Find out what they're plotting.

records.name: Demonic Retribution
records.description: Agents of the Burning Legion are hunting down refugee draenei from Shattrath. Gather the refugees and take them to safety.

records.name: Bad Day at Work
records.description: Several laborers have gone missing, and we fear that the arakkoa plan to burn them alive in sacrifice. We must save them!

records.name: Shattered Expectations
records.description: We have intel that a unit of Shattered Hand orcs is en route to assist the Iron Horde in Talador. Too bad they'll never make it.

records.name: Scared of the Dark
records.description: To the south lies Shadowfall Canyon, where wretched creatures are subjucating spirits of Fire, Earth, and Wind. Hopefully, no worse.

records.name: Spell Trouble
records.description: High ogres are enslaving gronn with pernicious magic, almost doubling the size of their army. We must put an end to the spellcasting.

records.name: Lessons of History
records.description: Shadowmoon orcs are summoning void beasts through hastily opened portals that could tear Draenor apart, once again. Stop them!

records.name: Drunk with Power
records.description: Gronn attacked an alchemist's wagon, and now they're hopped up on strength elixirs.  Let's get 'em before they find the invisibility potions.

records.name: Environmental Hazard
records.description: The genesaur and their botani minions are attacking caravans on the road to Talador. We'll make them rue the day they were sprouted!

records.name: Elements of Surprise
records.description: Our scouts spotted a group of ogre slavers gathering in Gorgrond. We cannot allow them a chance to fortify their position. Attack!

records.name: Lending a Hand
records.description: Shattered Hand raiders do not simply kill, they take trophies from their victims. We know their next target. Stop them.

records.name: Flock Together
records.description: Arakkoa flocks are looting abandoned draenei homesteads. They're also killing any who try to stop them. That makes them our problem now.

records.name: Peace unto You
records.description: The distressed spirits of fallen Azeroth soldiers have begun to rise. Quickly, let us end their torment.

records.name: Cat Scratch Fever
records.description: Some sadistic saberon think the chaos on Draenor means they can butcher innocents without fear of punishment. Disabuse them of that notion.

records.name: Fired Up
records.description: Some important Burning Blade orcs wish to discuss battle strategy with Iron Horde leaders. It would be a shame if they never arrived.

records.name: A Way Out
records.description: A group of defectors wishes to escape the Iron Horde! Let's clear the way for them.

records.name: Where The Rock Flayers Went
records.description: Modern anthropologists had hoped Draenor would reveal the origin of the rock flayer.  They were disappointed.

records.name: Umbrafen Treasures
records.description: Scouts have heard rumors of valuables within a mysterious cave in the Umbrafen.

records.name: Precious Riches
records.description: Rumors grow of a Pale orc that thrives on ambushing the unsuspecting for anything that shines.  He might be found in a cave to the southwest.

records.name: Borrok's Fools
records.description: The Grimfrost ogres regularly rob Frostwolf orcs and offer them as sacrifices to Brorrok the Devourer.  Let's relieve them of their stolen goods.

records.name: The Hypnocroak
records.description: Legends speak of a cave above the Nightmarsh replete with valuable trade resources - along with an amphibious abomination residing in it.

records.name: Aerial Rodents of Unusual Size
records.description: The frostwing screechers of the Southwind Cliffs are overpopulated.  If ignored, this will eventually disrupt mining operations.

records.name: Warpstalker Predators
records.description: We'll need to regularly fend off warpstalkers in the Shimmering Mor to ensure a steady supply of fey dragons for transport purposes.

records.name: Dessicus Maximus
records.description: The elementals of Gorgrond are regularly whipped into a frenzy by Dessicus of the Dead Pools.  Let's see what we can do about that.

records.name: Primal Savages
records.description: The saberon continue to be a menace to our outpost in Gorgrond.  Let's show them why this world isn't named Sabronia.

records.name: Artillery Suppression
records.description: Iron Horde artillery units have positioned themselves on the ridge above the Shivering Trench.  This is a clear and present danger!

records.name: Podlings of Unusual Size
records.description: Some say the podlings of Gloomshade Grove bow to the mad king of the east.  Find him, and end his reign of podling terror.

records.name: The Kaliri Nuisance
records.description: A reduced kaliri population would be greatly appreciated by virtually every hero moving about the skies, for all time.

records.name: Hapless Heroes
records.description: Scouting reports indicate some substandard adventurers are trapped in Deathweb Hollow.  I suppose we should lend a hand.

records.name: Raiders of the Lost Shard
records.description: The arakkoa have enslaved more outcasts and have resumed their excavation efforts.  Another setback for them is in order.

records.name: Orcs in the Mountains!
records.description: Kill the orcs in the mountains.

records.name: Orcs in the Mountains!
records.description: Kill the orcs in the mountains.

records.name: Honey I Got Your Money
records.description: Don't you worry.  Just make like a bear, get in, get the honey, and get out.

records.name: The Upper Hand
records.description: The Shattered Hand clan is positioned on the Shattered Rise and likely to strike again.  Handle it!

records.name: Gorging Ogres
records.description: The Highmaul ogres have an excavation underway at Stonecrag Gorge.  Get in there and extract information about their relics!

records.name: Lug'dol's Thugs
records.description: Lug'dol and his nascent brawler thugs are using our supply escorts for combat practice.  You know we can't allow this to continue.

records.name: Pier Pressure
records.description: The Iron Horde have built a harbor in Gorgrond that they call the Iron Docks. Show our enemy how fragile their vaunted "iron" truly is.

records.name: A Bird in the Hand
records.description: A little bird informed me that the arakkoa of Skyreach have been preying on our forward scouts. Make sure they regret that decision.

records.name: Return to Sender
records.description: Orcs from an alternate universe invaded our Blackrock Mountain. How ironic. Let's educate them on what happened to the previous residents.

records.name: No Rest for the Noble
records.description: Using a mausoleum as a staging ground is a completely new level of disrespect. Let's allow the departed to rest with smiles on their faces.

records.name: Miner Difficulties
records.description: The Bloodmaul use slave labor to fuel their efforts. If we liberate the miners, we'll disrupt their operations. Textbook win-win situation.

records.name: Off the Rails
records.description: Two words: Orcish engineering.  Even odds their rail system will take care of itself, but let's stack the odds in our favor.

records.name: Ziggy Sawdust X3-9
records.description: The Ziggy Sawdust X3-9 is the latest in clear-cutting technology. Unleash the adorable robot on the Everbloom and enjoy the show.

records.name: Two Feet in the Grave
records.description: How convenient of Ner'zhul and his lackeys to flee into their clan's burial grounds. It will make choosing their graves much quicker.

records.name: All Aboard the Fail Boat
records.description: Our enemies boast that their massive ship at the Iron Docks cannot be sunk. This crate of shiny new seaforium charges begs to differ.

records.name: Shiny!
records.description: The dread ravens are gathering scraps from below Skyreach. They are building more of those constructs or nests. They must be stopped.

records.name: Egg Them On!
records.description: The druids fear that the proto-drake populations are plummeting. Rescue their eggs from Warlord Zaela's army in Upper Blackrock Spire.

records.name: Auchindoom!
records.description: Scouts report that strange figures are lurking near Auchindoun, disturbing the mausoleums. We must destroy anything with even a hint of fel.

records.name: Fire and Fury
records.description: Rescuing slaves in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines is our priority, but to do this, we must thin the number of fire furies there.

records.name: Sparks and Steel
records.description: Goblin engineers are designing weapons for Blackrock and Thunderlord orcs. Well, we have weapons too. Go to Grimrail Depot and use them.

records.name: Savage Patch
records.description: Some magi stopped to smell the roses in the Everbloom. Oops. If we hurry, we should be able to save some of them.

records.name: Under Ner'zhul's Nose
records.description: Some of the Shadowmoon clan's treasures are poorly guarded. We'll take what we can and destroy the rest!

records.name: Listen All Y'all
records.description: They won't stand it. They'll know we planned it. The Iron Horde will think we're a mirage, but it's just sabotage.

records.name: Clawing Skyward
records.description: Atop Skyreach, the high arakkoa are building mechanical constructs as weapons of war. Stop them, but beware their dread raven guards.

records.name: Iron Horde's Blackrock
records.description: To siege the Iron Horde held Blackrock Spire, we must rid it of dragonkin and proto-dragons. Their mysterious keeper must also perish.

records.name: No Rest for Auchindoun
records.description: The Shadow Council is raising warriors interred at Auchindoun to create draenei constructs. Stop them before they defile the place further.

records.name: Waylay the Warlord
records.description: The Bloodmaul have discovered a powerful artifact, and their warlord is overseeing the excavation. Ambush the warlord and take the artifact.

records.name: Who's the Boss?
records.description: The Grimrail Depot owes its efficiency to goblin and orc overseers. Kill them, and you'll kill its ability to ship arms to distant camps.

records.name: Griefing with the Enemy
records.description: We dispatched a mage to deal with a hostile pack of genesaur, but now he's on their side. He must be infected. Time to send in the cavalry.

records.name: Frosticleave
records.description: Testing mission complete and all that.

records.name: Rescue on the Bloody Cliffs
records.description: The bloodmaul ogres of the Stonefury Cliffs are infamous as brutal slavemasters.  Show no quarter and free their slaves.

records.name: Ruinous Portents
records.description: If our troops are to become battle hardened, there would be no better test than the immense magnaron, Drov the Ruiner.

records.name: Rise to Power
records.description: The Sargerei have taken control of Socrethar's Rise and are establishing countless demonic portals, we can't let this continue.

records.name: An Eye for Terror
records.description: We need to shut down the legion gateways in operation within Shattrath.  Strike out at their vigilant watchful eyes.

records.name: Harboring Ill Will
records.description: The Iron Horde is running critical supply missions from the beach of Ironfist Harbor.  Three of our best should disrupt their operations.

records.name: Bladefist Hold
records.description: The Shattered Hand clan has established the ironically named Bladefist Hold.  Let's make a mockery of it.

records.name: Mother Araneae
records.description: With great risk comes great reward.  Plumb the dangers of Darksting Cave in southern Gorgrond and see what you can find.

records.name: Steamscar Plunder
records.description: The Steamscar of Gorgrond are notorious looters.  Let's repossess the valuables for great justice.

records.name: The Tomb of Lights
records.description: Shadow Council pillagers continue to ravage the Auchenai catacombs of the Tomb of Lights.

records.name: Reagents of Mass Destruction
records.description: As it happens, the reagents used by the Shadow Council fetch a handy sum on the black market.  We're certain there's a stockpile in Gul'rok.

records.name: Profiting From Profiteers
records.description: The goblins of Pinchwhistle *are* the noxious local environment.  I see no reason we shouldn't relieve them of some valuables.

records.name: Flint's Hide
records.description: Get it!

records.name: The Wolfmother's Pelts
records.description: The wolfmother Gar'lua raises the most ferocious of Warsong wolves.  Their pelts would dent the Warsong war effort and fetch a tidy sum.

records.name: Ug'lok the Incompetent
records.description: Even an ogre as incompetent as Ug'lok the Frozen can amass a fortune via slave labor, but be prepared to counter his magic should it happen to work.

records.name: The One True Brambleking
records.description: Rumor has it that Brambleking Fili's staff points the way to a hidden cache.  Myth?

records.name: Lost in the Foundry
records.description: The Iron Horde excavations taking place in The Pit occasionally turn up rare diamonds.  Retrieve one and we'll make use of it.

records.name: Blackrock Munitions
records.description: Not only does the ammunition of the Iron Horde carry value on the black market, but lifting some means less for the Earthbreaker cannon.

records.name: The Golden Halls of Skyreach
records.description: You and I both know the arakkoa are loaded.  Feels like we could make a fortune just chipping away at the walls.

records.name: Profitable Machinations
records.description: A joint operation between the Venture Co. and Iron Horde is taking place on Darktide Roost.  Profit must be some sort of motive.

records.name: Seas the Day
records.description: The Iron Docks have resumed operations despite our previous incursions. Let us show them how base their iron is against our mettle.

records.name: Murder Most Fowl
records.description: The denizens of Skyreach have stymied the war effort in arakkoan territory. Time to implement our new strategy: Operation Open Season.

records.name: Eviction
records.description: The Iron Horde and its lackeys have "energetically" refused to vacate our own Blackrock Mountain. Go collect back rent from their corpses.

records.name: A Grave Mistake
records.description: The Sargerei and their allies continue their desecration of Auchindoun. I recommend executing our "no traitor left behind alive" policy.

records.name: Labor Dispute
records.description: Ogres are bringing in slaves to shore up defenses in the mines. Free the slaves, and the area will be vulnerable to attack.

records.name: Logistics Are For Professionals
records.description: The Blackrocks need an uninterrupted supply of metal to fuel production of their war machines. Let's make life difficult for them.

records.name: Rustle in the Bushes
records.description: The natives are restless. Again. The Kirin Tor have asked us to help them with some "gardening."

records.name: To Rest Again
records.description: Our shaman have prepared a ritual to return souls summoned by the Shadowmoon to rest. Go and perform this ritual at the burial grounds.

records.name: Running Aground
records.description: The Iron Horde's flagship is at the Iron Docks. It's intimidating, but if it's steered into a shoal, it'll founder like any other boat.

records.name: Is It a Bird? A Zeppelin?
records.description: Apexis devices are sun powered, but what if the sun is blocked? Zeppelins will work, and the goblins might help. Go, but pack airsick bags.

records.name: Lava, Lava Everywhere
records.description: A fortress in a volcano is both ingenious and foolhardy. Impenetrable, yes, but a shaman can cause an eruption that will decimate it.

records.name: Clearing the Caches
records.description: Soulbinder Nyami has hidden caches of reagents for the Sargerei's summoning rituals all across Auchindoun. Find the caches and destroy them.

records.name: Shafted Miners
records.description: A mineshaft has collapsed, and those Bloodmaul dogs have left the enslaved miners down there to die. We must dig them out!

records.name: Got a Light?
records.description: A train full of artillery and explosives is about to leave the depot. Detonating one bomb should be enough to destroy the entire payload.

records.name: Spored to Death
records.description: The river we've been using as our water source has been tainted by those nasty spores! Find a new source before people get thirsty.

records.name: Ghost Wranglers
records.description: The spirits of the burial grounds are restless. Seek their knowledge and their power to end Ner'zhul's scheming once and for all.

records.name: Rollin' like a Kraken
records.description: With some diving gear and a little luck, a seaborne attack could be our best chance of infiltrating the heavily fortified Iron Docks.

records.name: Operation Skybreach
records.description: The arakkoa view us "ground dwellers" as nothing more than beasts. Let us see what they think after we lay waste to their lofty spires.

records.name: We Have a Mole
records.description: Getting into Blackrock Spire will not be easy, but we have a secret weapon: mole machines. The Black Irons will never know what hit them.

records.name: The Lost World
records.description: A portal in Auchindoun links Draenor to the demon world of Argus. Cut off the Legion's reinforcements: destroy every trace of the portal.

records.name: Sixteen Tons
records.description: Slaves in the Slag Mines are ripe for revolt. Aid them. Then ask if they've dug up any powerful relics lately. Try to be subtle.

records.name: Can't Go Home This Way
records.description: Trains symbolize inevitability, but you've never put much stock in fate. That's good: you've got a huge infrastructure to shatter.

records.name: Magical Mystery Tour
records.description: The Kirin Tor who were sent to Gorgrond have gone silent. Turned or slain? Find out what's going on, and get them back on task if you can.

records.description: The time for a critical assault on Highmaul is at hand.  To victory!

records.description: Rumored not to exist, yet clearly baseless.

records.name: Finding Farahlon
records.description: The Netherstorm must have come from somewhere.  Get on a boat, sail northeast, and bring something good back while you're at it.

records.name: Tracking Griftah
records.description: Some shifty troll sold our troops a bunch of worthless junk.  Rough him up a bit and get a refund!

records.name: Mysteries of Lok-rath
records.description: The Warsong clan stationed in Lok-rath is rumored to stockpile some strange form of currency.  It may hold some historic significance.

records.name: Clean the Latrine
records.description: It's best not to lose a bet with the janitor.

records.name: Mogor's Dilemma
records.description: Mogor the Ogre is having trouble with some gladiators, but slaughtering other ogres would look bad for him.  He'll pay us for the dirty work.

records.name: The Bloodmane Scrolls
records.description: The ruthless war prides of the Bloodmane have made off with the Reveries of Sethek, scrolls sacred to the outcasts.

records.name: The Liberation of Shattrath
records.description: The once-great city of Shattrath continues to be subjugated by the legion.  Cry havoc, and let slip the followers of war.

records.name: The Ring of Trials
records.description: Sometimes, a follower's skills just aren't cutting the mustard.  The ring offers a rare opportunity to retrain.

records.name: Drov the Ruiner
records.description: Gorgrond plays host to one of the most fearsome creatures in all Draenor.  Tremble before his might, but come back with some plunder afterwards.

records.name: Rukhmar
records.description: A manifestation of a Sun God, Rukhmar demands fealty and obedience.  She will not be defeated easily.

records.name: Errand for the SPS
records.description: If you really want to join the Steamwheedle Preservation Society, you've got to really care about Highmaul artifacts.

records.name: Blingtron's Secret Vault
records.description: While we were occupied with the sabotage of the Dark Portal, Blingtron managed to build a vault of riches.  Find it!

records.name: Hearthstone Tournament
records.description: We could use a master tactician around here.  Plus, we might get some autographs.

records.name: Hearthstone Tournament
records.description: We could use a master tactician around here.  Plus, we might get some autographs.

records.name: The Burning Crusade
records.description: Rumor has it there's a chili cook-off soon, and frankly I'm tired of eating the same gruel every day.  Send someone to get whatever wins.

records.name: Path of the Titans
records.description: Behold!  Endless customization awaits in this system within a system within a system.

records.name: Tusks Like Icicles
records.description: Coldtusk the boar continues to roam the shivering trench, and clearly we can't rely on the ravagers to take care of him.

records.name: Fury of the Southwind Cliffs
records.description: The furies that roam the Southwind Cliffs have been known to leave their dead frozen in place.  Perhaps there are things worth retrieving.

records.name: The Umbral Giant
records.description: The marshes of the Umbrafen are the stomping ground of Ba'ruun, a danger to all that need enter the fen.

records.name: The Hills of Talbuk Past
records.description: Rumors speak of a ghostly talbuk that haunts the southern reaches of Shadowmoon Valley, we should investigate.

records.name: Rolkor
records.description: Comb the northern wastelands of Gorgond for Rolkor.  Find him and defeat him for the glory of the garrison.

records.name: Breaker of the Blue Flame
records.description: Our scouts speak of a cavern in northern Gorgrond in which a strange ogron named Gelgor of the Blue Flame lies.

records.name: The Mother of All Kaliri
records.description: Hen-Mother Hami.  She who breeds the swooping terrors of the sky.  Find her, subdue her, and restore freedom to the skies.

records.name: Steeltusk Lives
records.description: The Iron Horde have equipped a particularly violent elekk named Steeltusk.  Let's make sure this doesn't become more common.

records.name: Murkbog Terror
records.description: Scouts report a many-headed beast named Festerbloom waylaying travelers crossing the Murkbog.  Clear the path for everyone's sake.

records.name: Ancient of Corruption
records.description: Rumors swirl of an ancient gone awry in the undergrowth.  Track down this "Shadowbark" and take care of business.

records.name: The Gorian Warmaster
records.description: We've isolated the murderous Warmaster Blugthol to a tower within Mar'gok's Overwatch.  It's time to take him out.

records.name: Heart of the Sabermaw
records.description: Just north of Grommashar dwell the Sabermaw clan, notorious outpost raiders.  Strike out at their leader, Soulfang, and crush their morale.

records.name: Boom Is the Word
records.description: A very large Iron Horde fuel-storage tank sits alongside a rail bridge to the north. Crack the tank open, add some dynamite.  BOOM!

records.name: Too Much Business
records.description: We suspect a goblin merchant of selling to both us and the Iron Horde. Tail him, and if he is double-dealing, drag him back by his ears.

records.name: Raiding the Raiders
records.description: Iron Horde raiders have descended on nearby draenei villages. Find the raiders' camp and raid it. Turnabout, they say, is fair play.

records.name: What's Mine Is A Mine
records.description: Word has it that an Iron Horde mine near our outpost has hit a rich vein. We can't let them have nice things. Storm in and claim the mine.

records.name: Iron Horde Chef
records.description: Iron Horde cuisine is revolting, but the refugees need food. Find orc camps and pilfer what rations they have. Mints might be prudent too.

records.name: Thunderlords, Ho!
records.description: Rumor has it that the Thunderlord clan is using strange "blades of omen" that can change size. Destroy these weapons while we can.

records.name: Warchief's Pride
records.description: Grommash has a legendary ego and temper. Hit the Warsong hard and he'll be consumed with the need for vengeance. We want him distracted.

records.name: Hefty Metal
records.description: Blackrock scouts have discovered a vast trove of metal ore perfect for making weapons. Make sure they never report their findings.

records.name: The Dark Night Rises
records.description: Curiously, our scouts say a Shadowmoon encampment is always vulnerable at night. You'd think they'd be more used to the dark. Oh well.

records.name: Shattered Land
records.description: Some Shattered Hand raiders have scattered, but though they look haggard, they may soon find new victims to splatter.

records.name: Ogre-Stepping Boundaries
records.description: Those Highmaul ogres are annexing more land than we can afford to lose. We're green-lighting a terminal solution to this problem: you.

records.name: It'll Be Ogre Soon
records.description: Bloodmaul ogres enslave others and then rely on their forced labor. Go inspire the downtrodden by kicking the fight out of their oppressors.

records.name: Ogre Confident
records.description: The Bladespire clan has concocted a "foolproof" plan of defense. Make it backfire by killing their elite and leaving their "fools" alive.

records.name: Spring Preening
records.description: We cannot allow the arakkoa to acquire more of their deadly Apexis technology. Raid their excavation sites. Leave nothing but dust behind!

records.name: Pluck Them All
records.description: Our alchemists have found uses for the oils secreted by arakkoa feathers. Gather as many as you can - by any means necessary.

records.name: Mean Screech
records.description: We have crafted a device to mimic an arakkoa's cries for help. Deploy it in the Spires of Arak to draw our feathery foes into an ambush.

records.name: Mulch Ado about Nothing
records.description: The podlings have been raiding the graves of our allies to feed one of their genesaur. Recover the bodies. If they want mulch, mulch them!

records.name: Lunch Breakers
records.description: We need to get the gronn riled again. Kill the local meat-based wildlife and see if starvation turns them against the Iron Horde nearby.

records.name: Night of the Primals
records.description: Our scouts report that the botani are snatching workers from the quarries. Kill the primals and find out what they are using the orcs for.

records.name: Green Fel
records.description: The reckless warlock Gul'dan intends to create a fel volcano in the center of Shadowmoon Valley. Stop him before he dooms us all.

records.name: Highway to Fel
records.description: Shadow Council agents plan to cut a path through Tanaan and pave it with their enemies' bones. Such an atrocity must not come to pass.

records.name: Felraiser
records.description: Warlocks in the northwest are draining life from the land, preparing to summon a demon lord. Well? Don't just stand there!

records.name: Beyond the Pale
records.description: Pale orcs stole a powerful trinket and fled to the mountains. Now they vow to kill anyone who comes near "the precious." Challenge accepted!

records.name: Bucket Brigade
records.description: Massive flooding has cut off our supply lines, and the water elementals responsible show no signs of stopping. Let's hang them out to dry.

records.name: Deathhoof
records.description: A doomsday weapon has been enchanted to look like an adorable baby clefthoof. Clefthoof violently defend their young. Proceed with caution.

records.name: Rock the Boat
records.description: Disrupt tense negotiations between the Iron Horde and the Highmaul ogres to acquire an Abrogator Stone for Khadgar.

records.name: He Keeps it Where?
records.description: A powerful Bloodmaul magma-shaper is using an Abrogator Stone as a piece of navel jewelry. Don't tell Khadgar where we got it.

records.name: Lost in the Weeds
records.description: A failed Stonemaul assault on the Overlook Ruins has left ogre corpses everywhere. Search them for an Abrogator stone!

records.name: It's Rigged!
records.description: Ogres are wagering an Abrogator Stone on an upcoming Ring of Blood gladiatorial contest. Send in the ringers.

records.name: Tower of Terror
records.description: Scouts have discovered a ruined ogre guard tower in Talador. It's haunted. Also, we're running out of scouts.

records.name: The Pits
records.description: Good news! We've located some Elemental Runes that Khadgar is looking for. Bad News: They're in The Pits.

records.name: The Great Train Robbery
records.description: The Iron Horde is moving an Elemental Rune via train to the Blackrock Foundry. It's ambush time.

records.name: A Rune With a View
records.description: In the chaos of the battle of Shattrath, the Sargerei absconded with some of the Elemental Runes that Khadgar is looking for.

records.name: Rocks Fall. Everyone Dies.
records.description: The Iron Horde have subjugated a stone fury in Ironfist Harbor. It's got the Elemental Runes Khadgar seeks.

records.name: Beyond the Pale
records.description: The Bladefist clan are capturing pale prisoners. We suspect they're looking for the same Elemental Runes as Khadgar.

records.name: Pumping Iron
records.description: Elemental Runes have been smuggled into the Iron Siegeworks. Essentially a suicide mission. Send followers you don't like.

records.name: Wanted: Amethon
records.description: Amethon has been long forgotten, deep in a cave in Talador. His crystals are very valuable.

records.name: Wanted: Gor'thul
records.description: Gor'thul, betrayer of the Shattered Hand, is an outcast. It is said he has befriended a lot of cats.

records.name: Wanted: Nullifier Darkoor
records.description: Nullifier Darkoor has been in hiding long enough. It's time to take him down and put an end to the Fel Breakers once and for all.

records.name: Wanted: Undertow
records.description: Undertow appears from the depths, pulling boats into the sea and destroying our lines of contact between Tanaan Jungle and Shadowmoon Valley.

records.name: Wanted: Tremor
records.description: A massive rockworm has taken residence on the shores of Gorgrond, devouring the local lobstroks.

records.name: Wanted: Hivelord Ik'rix
records.description: Hemet Nesingwary would be very interested in his head.

records.name: Relic Hunter: Amulet of Rukhmar
records.description: Claim the power of the arakkoa god before the Adherents of Rukhmar can take it for themselves.

records.name: Relic Hunter: Grimoire of Nameless Void
records.description: Destroy the ancient barrier to access this dark and powerful tome.

records.name: Relic Hunter: Gronnsbane
records.description: Seek the blessings of Frostfire to empower the ancient Thunderlord spear.

records.name: Relic Hunter: Silent Skull
records.description: Take the cursed skull mask from the legendary Laughing Skull assassin.

records.name: Relic Hunter: Dream of Argus
records.description: Recover the ancient crystal shards to restore this mysterious artifact of the draenei.

records.description: A disgruntled Bladespire Chef has provided us with a lead on an ancient map hidden in the mines beneath the citadel.

records.name: It's a Jungle Out There
records.description: A Steamscar saberon has been caught skulking around our walls. If we let him go, he's agreed to sell out a rival shaman who has been mapping the location of many hidden treasures.

records.name: Fields of Sorrow
records.description: A farmer claims knowledge of where many of Talador's secrets are hidden, and will share them if we'll help destroy the demons that ruined his land.

records.name: Bird Watching
records.description: Rumors are swirling that a raid on an Outcast hovel has yielded a particularly interesting map. Intercept the arakkoa before they return to Skyreach!

records.name: Highplains Robbery
records.description: A Warsong elder carrying historical documents important to the clan is communing at the Elemental Plateau. Relieve her of her burdens.

records.name: Tomb Raider
records.description: Ancient carvings in the tombs of the Fortress of Anguish may lead us to discover many secrets in Shadowmoon Valley. We'll have to fight our way in.

records.name: Mushroom Mystery
records.description: The Umbrafen swamps have been overgrown by giant fungi for as long as anyone can remember - why are Ogre ruins buried here?

records.name: I See Dead Orcs
records.description: The Shadowmoon Clan have interred their dead in this area for generations - find out more about their history.

records.name: The Bigger They Are
records.description: The Thunderlord regard Colossal's Fall as a sacred location, claiming it was their clan who felled this Colossal many decades ago.

records.name: Boiling Hot Magma
records.description: Relics of long-forgotten orc clans can be found by carefully traversing between the Daggermaw Flows lava streams - and dealing with deadly fire elementals.

records.name: Backbreaker
records.description: The Iron Horde are attempting to unearth long-lost ogre artifacts in the Broken Spine area. Evict them and claim the rewards as your own.

records.name: Green Thumb
records.description: The botani have claimed the abandoned ogre fortress at the Overlook Ruins as a new incubator. Stop them before they overgrow all of Gorgrond.

records.name: We Will Fight In the Shadar
records.description: The outcast arakkoa were forced to abandon much of their written knowledge and history when the high arakkoa attacked Veil Shadar.

records.name: I See Dead Ogres
records.description: The ghosts of ogre sorcerers haunt the Ango'rosh ruins, guarding artifacts forgotten by all others.

records.name: Pro-Labor
records.description: The high arakkoa have enslaved their outcast brethren to dig in the apexis excavation site, looking for ancient artifacts. Set the workers free.

records.name: Fall From Grace
records.description: Many shiny trinkets and precious valuables have been lost in Sethekk Hollow, the place where cursed arakkoa are cast out from Skyreach.

records.name: Forced Eviction
records.description: The Steamwheedle Preservation Society management needs the Stonecrag dig site to be an ogre-free zone before their workers will agree to excavate, and have promised a cut of the proceeds if we help out.

records.name: Early Mover
records.description: We've heard reports that the Steamwheedle Preservation Society is looking to start a dig site at the razed Warsong outpost - why wait for them when you can claim the easy finds now?

records.name: Mountain of Spirits
records.description: The ancient communal site of Oshu'gun holds offerings from various orc clans. If not for the murderous void elementals unleashed by the pale, it would be a nice place to visit.

records.name: Herb Infused
records.description: A monstrous beast roams the Murkbog.  Our alchemists say they can harvest it for a bounty of alchemy supplies.

records.name: Battlefield Scavengers
records.description: Scavengers gnaw and pick at the fallen.  Kill them so we can do some scavenging of our own.

records.name: Flux to Give
records.description: Blacksmiths know that furies can be harvested for the best flux.  Snuff the fires and bring it home.

records.name: Enchanted Weapons
records.description: The Shadowmoon clan possess weaponry we can harness for raw magic.  Raid their encampment and collect their enchanted weapons.

records.name: Big Hands, Big Swords
records.description: Ogre are known to possess massive, thick, and long swords.  Disenchanting them makes a tremendous amount of dust.

records.name: The Wonder Gears
records.description: Our engineers are excited about tearing apart a siege engine for parts.  Let's take one down and let them have their fun.

records.name: You're Fired
records.description: The pale are expert scavengers.  Let's relieve them of some of that salvage.

records.name: Jewels of Denial
records.description: The arakkoa decorate their weapons and armor with fantastic jewels.  Acquire them and let our jewelcrafters cut them into something useful.

records.name: Waste Not, Want Not
records.description: Apparently the goren can't digest the valuable gems they eat.  Your mission should be clear.

records.name: Spy Games
records.description: If we can decipher some stolen iron horde documents, we can find and assassinate their scouts.

records.name: The Quill is Mighty
records.description: It's time to make some changes to the Iron Horde's orders.  If we can kill the guards, we can rewrite history before it happens.

records.name: That's Some Bull
records.description: There's some rather large clefthoof in Nagrand.  Let's take one down before they are killed by trappers.

records.name: Kill and Cut
records.description: Iron Horde tents are made from rugged leather that can be crafted into fine leather armor.

records.name: Nest Raid
records.description: Rylak's collect an immense amount of fur when building their nests.  Raid a nest and recover the fur.

records.name: Hunting the Hunters
records.description: The garn are primarily known for their ferocity, but they are only slightly lesser well known for their sumptuous furry pelts.

records.name: Apexis Nexus
records.description: Our need for equipment upgrades never ends, take a few of our best to the apexis excavation site.

records.name: Prime Directive
records.description: We'll leave the elementals of Nagrand to themselves right after we've gotten some of the elemental samples we need.

records.name: Ring of Cooperation
records.description: Head to neutral ground at the Ring of Trials and learn a thing or two about fighting alongside ogres.

records.name: Outcast Relations
records.description: As we have a number of arakkoa allies, let's run some joint operations to build relations.

records.name: You, Robot
records.description: With the installation of a negatronic control unit, a true emotional bond between lifeform and machine can happen!  Get one!

records.name: Summer is Here
records.description: The saberon have highly developed rituals and customs.  Live among them, learn their ways, and gain strength from this experience.

records.name: Field Photography
records.description: We need someone to document the devastation taking place here on Draenor. Head to Nagrand and photograph all you can.

records.name: Lens Some Hands
records.description: Your photos turned out great, but now we need some more creative shots. Head back out to the field and see what you can do!

records.name: Lessons of the Blade
records.description: You will find Yozshura the Blademaster atop Mount Volwrath.  Seek his wisdom, challenge him, and return enlightened.

records.name: Takeout Pizza
records.description: The troops are hungry, go pick up a few pies.

records.name: The Search for Red Dawn
records.description: An Iron Horde submarine is making a break for our shipyard.  Take it out.

records.name: Rob's Test Mission
records.description: kill stuff

records.name: Searching for the Light
records.description: We need to find more paladin allies if we are to have any hope of bringing the fight to the Legion.

records.name: Eyes to the Skies
records.description: There have been sightings of Legion scouts in the skies above the forest canopy.

records.name: Lost to History
records.description: An ancient scroll in our archives describes a Titan communicator somewhere in Val'Sharah that could provide us with invaluable knowledge.

records.name: [PH] Test Mission 2
records.description: [ph] description

records.name: [PH] Test Mission 3
records.description: [ph] description

records.name: [PH] Test Mission 4
