records.name: Blockade: Zangar Sea
records.description: The Horde have set up a blockade around their garrison.  Break through and you can raid the Horde navy.

records.name: Blockade: Barrier Sea
records.description: Assault the Iron Horde defense in the Barrier Sea to unlock access to the waters around Tanaan.  Success grants access to Hellfire Citadel naval missions.

records.name: Blockade: Evanescent Sea
records.description: The Alliance have set up a blockade around their garrison.  Break through to raid and plunder.

records.name: Blockade: South Sea
records.description: Push the Iron Horde out of the South Seas by defeating their blockade.  Success grants access to the primal resources around Nagrand.

records.name: The Second Time is the Charm
records.description: Now that our ships are more equipped, re-engage the enemy.  It's lurking in the same area.

records.name: The Second Time is the Charm
records.description: Now that our ships are more equipped, re-engage the enemy.  It's lurking in the same area.

records.name: Sink or Swim
records.description: You've never lived until you've taken down an enemy vessel while you're both flirting with watery disaster.

records.name: Broken Horn Village
records.description: These destroyers plan to shell a Laughing Skull village near the Iron Docks. It's our closest foothold against the Iron Horde. We can't lose it.

records.name: Sneaking.  Sea Style.
records.description: We designed submarines specifically to sneak up on unsuspecting carriers.  We've set up a carrier in the reef for you to practice.

records.name: Fine Tuning Depth Charges
records.description: We've set up submarines at different depths in Frostfire Bay.  Take a destroyer out and train them in the art of sub hunting.

records.name: While the Iron Is Hot
records.description: Although goren infest the Molten Quarry, iron ore is plentiful there. So are Alliance scum. Don't let that destroyer secure their grip on the area.

records.name: Shattered Light
records.description: Demons and Shadow Council agents have overrun much of Shattrath. Even so, we will keep fighting. We shall not yield while the Alliance still stands.

records.name: Retaining Control
records.description: We've heard rumors of a powerful new demon presence in Faronaar. We should investigate before it threatens our hold on the area.

records.name: The Light Reveals
records.description: There is a powerful beacon of the Light somewhere in Azsuna. We should find it.

records.name: A Friend In Need
records.description: Senegos' prime consort has sent out a cry for help. We owe it to our allies to send aid.

records.name: Toxic Behavior
records.description: Iron Horde forces have been harvesting potent toxins in the Writhing Mire and using them in combat. Now they're shipping a batch of toxins north.

records.name: Skeleton Crew
records.description: This sub just limped back home for repairs, only to find the harbor nearly deserted. Finish off the sub while we keep the enemy busy elsewhere.

records.name: Riders on the Storm
records.description: These two vessels are heading south in a hurricane. Even Hellscream wouldn't have sent them out unless their mission was dire. We must intercept them.

records.name: Hoard Overboard
records.description: Rumor has it a cargo fleet recently sank out here, far from land. Unfortunately we're not the only ones who've heard this rumor.

records.name: Windroc Bay
records.description: Surely these vessels are just ferrying bird enthusiasts to the bay. Not beast tamers who plan to enslave its massive hydras for the Iron Horde. Surely.

records.name: The Sunset Shore
records.description: The Iron Horde uses subs to transport gold up and down the western coast. Taking one out would hit Hellscream's pocket and fill our coffers.

records.name: Glittering Prize
records.description: This enemy sub is loaded with gold, so it can't outrun us. Instead, it's been hiding out between a rocky shoal and a whirlpool, hoping to lure us to our doom.

records.name: False Economy
records.description: A damaged engine has crippled a destroyer far from shore. That's what happens when you only value warriors and plunder. Not that the gold should go waste.

records.name: No Loss of Suction
records.description: While mutineers were seizing this destroyer, storms broke out, and a whirlpool ensnared the ship. That's bad luck. And thanks to us, it's about to get worse.

records.name: A Sunless Sea
records.description: In this poor weather, Hellscream has sent subs to harry our fleet. Act decisively so that they never again see the light of day.

records.name: Blood in the Water
records.description: Enemy destroyers are terrorizing the waters west of the Spires of Arak. Crushing them won't restore the lives that've been lost, but it'd be a good start.

records.name: Dead Calm
records.description: With no wind and a ripped mainsail, an enemy carrier has slowed to a crawl, along with its escorts. Make sure their troops and cargo never make landfall.

records.name: Wrack and Rune
records.description: Enemy subs have taken a sudden interest in this area. They may be tracking down an elemental rune. In the wrong hands, it could prove devastating.

records.name: Fury of the Elements
records.description: Storms have broken out around the Ancestral Grounds. The enemy vessel off the coast may be to blame. Also the fact that most shaman loathe the Iron Horde.

records.name: Un-sub-tle
records.description: Evidently Hellscream thought subs might be a safer way to transport elemental runes. Safer, yes. Sneaky, no.

records.name: Turn! Turn! Turn!
records.description: Hellscream should realize by now that the elements won't willingly serve the Iron Horde. And trying to compel their obedience is unwise.

records.name: One Way or Another
records.description: Lately the Iron Horde has been gathering magical items. They've learned brute force can't solve everything. Remind them it still has its uses.

records.name: Abracadabra
records.description: A shipment of abrogator stones is on its way to Grommashar. We must intercept it. The Iron Horde is trouble enough without a bunch of magical gems.

records.name: Magical Mystery Cruise
records.description: An enemy carrier has veered off course, and it's emanating powerful magic. Something odd is afoot. Find out what. More importantly, claim that magic.

records.name: A Kind of Magic
records.description: Several magi and their schooner have been taken into the Iron Horde's "protection". Rescue the magi. Their gratitude could pay well.

records.name: Ru'klaa
records.description: Iron Horde vessels are often attacked by lobstrok here, and so Hellscream means to slay their matriarch. Coming to her aid would be in our best interests.

records.name: Talk to the Fist
records.description: Northwest of Talador, offshore, is an unyielding rock vise called the Colossal's Fist. The Iron Horde hasn't yet discovered it. Arrange an introduction.

records.name: The White Kraken
records.description: Captain Ironbeard is a deadly menace on the seas, but he's obsessed with a kraken that doesn't exist. Distract him and then launch a sneak attack.

records.name: Storm Front
records.description: Shattered Hand forces just dispatched these vessels, which headed straight into a storm. Their recklessness will work to our advantage.

records.name: Subtle Plans Are Here Again
records.description: Subtlety isn't really Hellscream's strong suit. Probably these ships thought the mountains would hide their approach.

records.name: Spoiling for a Fight
records.description: So what if they're nowhere near Horde or Alliance waters? Sooner or later, they will be.

records.name: Felblazer
records.description: These ships were loaded with containers of raw fel before they left Ironhold Harbor. Wherever they're headed, we must destroy them and their deathly cargo.

records.name: Oops, We Hit Them Again
records.description: The Iron Horde keeps sending fresh workers and supplies to the Dark Portal. Should we take pity and let their ships through so they can rebuild it? No.

records.name: Try Evading This
records.description: These bastards have been playing tag with our forces, landing hits on our forces, only to evade our counterattacks. It's hurting our troops and their morale.

records.name: To Fel and Back
records.description: Kilrogg Deadeye has made his choice. Now his Bleeding Hollow orcs travel to Hellfire Citadel and return to Tanaan empowered by demonic blood.

records.name: Warspear Fishing
records.description: Hellscream has posted a sub near the Horde's main base on Ashran. Take that sub out. Alliance, that means you, too. Factional hatreds have no place here.

records.name: If a Tree Falls in the Forest
records.description: Iron Horde forces have landed in Tangleheart, endangering its rich soil and plentiful timber. Also its powerful ancients. Who were already pretty angry.

records.name: A Ship in Harbor Is Safe, But...
records.description: These ships are about to leave Ironhold Harbor. They're probably still hung over from last-minute partying. They're certainly not expecting a fight.

records.name: Strait and Narrow
records.description: An enemy carrier has seized control of the Darktide Strait. Losing that waterway would hurt Horde shipping concerns worldwide. Our course is clear.

records.name: Back in My Day...
records.description: A true warrior would only hunt a sub in bad weather. Barefoot. In arctic waters. Against the current. Both ways.

records.name: One, Two... Plenty
records.description: Outmanned thirty to one. Alliance weaklings would call this a risky fight. In the Horde, we call it a target-rich environment.

records.name: Luck Is Also a Skill
records.description: Battleship counters destroyer, but carrier counters battleship. Sub counters carrier, but destroyer counters sub. In short, luck will decide this fight.

records.name: Fools and Their Gold
records.description: The city of Elodor houses the draenei's leaders, who are allied with the Alliance. Teach both groups a lesson: seize one of their gold shipments.

records.name: The Shimmer Moor
records.description: The so-called dragons living here are fragile mounts, but foolish draenei pay well for them. Divert their latest cargo of gold to a better cause: ours.

records.name: Do You Feel Lucky?
records.description: When Alliance forces sailed to Shadowmoon, their ship arrived intact. Maybe draenei aren't as cursed as we thought. Maybe they even brought gold with them.

records.name: Skulls, Spikes, Everything Nice
records.description: The mail armor in this vessel's cargo hold will serve us well once we spice it up a bit.

records.name: Look Good in Leather
records.description: This vessel is taking a cargo full of leather armor to Alliance fighters in Zeth'Kur. Leather shouldn't be wasted on them. Isn't lace more their thing?

records.name: A Journey, Not a Destination
records.description: This Alliance carrier is heading for Stormshield with fresh troops and supplies. But it's a long journey between Shadowmoon Valley and Ashran.

records.name: Far From Home
records.description: Cowardly Alliance dogs have begun targeting our carriers even when they are far from Shadowmoon waters. Show them what a true threat looks like.

records.name: With Their Boots On
records.description: The waters around Shadowmoon Valley are regularly patrolled by Alliance subs, but these two are far from shore. They look lonely. Let's send them company.

records.name: Made for Walking
records.description: If we steal Alliance-bound boots, and a barefoot Alliance mage trips and dies, would that count as a Horde victory? Why, yes. Plus, hey, new boots.

records.name: Mayhem by the Moonlit Shore
records.description: Horde vessels wanted for Alliance raid. Must love plunder and long walks on the beach. High tolerance for the colors blue and violet a plus.

records.name: By Our Bootstraps
records.description: Alliance forces in Shadowmoon have an easy life. Lush forests, mild weather, supply shipments... maybe even fresh bacon. Make those bastards pay.

records.name: Mail Delivery, Rain or Shine
records.description: The Earthen Ring kindly requests that all plundered mail armor be divided equally among those who wear it. Otherwise, the elements might become displeased.

records.name: Steel Fist, Silk Glove
records.description: A shipment of tailored goods from Shadowmoon Valley is headed for our enemies in Stormshield. Intercept it, and share in the spoils.

records.name: Say No to Southern Exposure
records.description: Draenei-crafted plate is just as sturdy as Horde-crafted plate. Tell your soldiers they will seize and wear this cargo, or they will go naked into battle.

records.name: Circle of Life
records.description: Another day, another Alliance shipment to Ashran. Are they trying to be stealthy, heading so far east before circling back to Stormshield? Pathetic.

records.name: The Tanaan Channel
records.description: An enemy carrier guards the channel entrance. If we take it out, we can storm Scuttler's Coast to the north, and cut off Alliance shipments to the south.

records.name: Alakazam
records.description: With Archmage Khadgar elsewhere on business, an enemy vessel has secured the eastern passage into Zangarra. They expect a fight. Let's not disappoint them.

records.name: If It Shines, It's Mine
records.description: This vessel is carrying plenty of plate armor; Alliance soldiers just happen to be wearing it. Why are you letting Alliance scum wear your armor?

records.name: It's a Trap
records.description: This destroyer looks to be disabled far from land. But our scouts report this is just an act: a submarine is circling in the waters below.

records.name: Heart of the Sea
records.description: These radiant and perilous waters absorbed their magical properties from precious stones lining the sea floor. Such a gem would make a powerful necklace.

records.name: The Cerulean Lagoon
records.description: The name sounds peaceful, but your crew should bring gas masks. The atmosphere here tends to be toxic, which is doubtless why the Horde sent a sub.

records.name: Bring Home the Bacon
records.description: Frostboar Point is tactically worthless; it hardly merits a carrier patrol. Somehow the Horde has discovered our plans to export the area's boars.

records.name: Spring Is Never Coming
records.description: The orcs who named the Coldsnap Coast didn't mean that its weather was a temporary cold spell. They meant the cold would snap most people in two.

records.name: The Stonefury Cliffs
records.description: Bloodmaul ogres live here alongside their ogron masters, who constantly hammer the ground with boulders. All in all, it's a fun getaway spot.

records.name: Tastes Like Chicken
records.description: Frostangler Bay is a virtual cornucopia of disgusting-looking marine life. But it's palatable enough if you cook it properly. Bring back a fat haul.

records.name: Come Fel or High Water
records.description: Horde forces plan to attack the Icescar Boneyard. If they fail, their deaths will only fuel the Shadow Council's foul sorcery. Stop the Horde, whatever it takes.

records.name: Zangar Shore
records.description: Several races on Draenor offer excellent pay for these giant mushrooms. That said, the shortsighted Horde will quickly wipe them out if we don't intervene.

records.name: The Burning Glacier
records.description: Yes, it's constantly snowing here, but it also has volcanic activity. No, it's never a comfortable temperature. Look, you're not going ashore anyway.

records.name: Cold Shoulder
records.description: This far north, Horde forces seem to think themselves safe from our ships. But then thinking never was their strong suit.

records.name: Mind Over Metal
records.description: Battleship counters destroyer, but carrier counters battleship. Sub counters carrier, but destroyer counters sub. Thus, skill will be this fight's deciding factor.

records.name: You Pull a Gun
records.description: Driven by bloodlust, orc animals target our carriers even when they're far from Frostfire waters. We won't meekly endure this aggression. Strike back.

records.name: Dead Orcs Don't Need Boots
records.description: Stop complaining. You never know: they might not smell that bad.

records.name: Far Too Many Notes
records.description: Our spies have noted regular supply shipments to Wor'gol via the Southwind Cliffs. The Horde hasn't noted our noting them. We've noted that, too.

records.name: Pedal to the Metal
records.description: These Horde vessels are rounding Highmaul on their way north. If ogres don't seize their cargo of plate armor, it will soon outfit our enemies. Stop them.

records.name: Glacier Bay
records.description: When Horde forces sailed to Frostfire, their ship arrived mostly intact. Perhaps orcs aren't witless brutes. Unless they left behind valuable cargo.

records.name: Hand-Me-Downs
records.description: Pretend you're getting them from a big brother or sister. But give them a thorough scrubbing before you put them on. Just in case.

records.name: The Touch, the Feel
records.description: The orcs of Throm'var are supplying the Horde with fine furs and supple leather. Such a pity they'll be used to garb our boorish foes.

records.name: Heavy Metal
records.description: These battleships are so overburdened with cargo, their sailors hardly need to swab the decks. Teach them the value of caution, and lighten their load.

records.name: Take up the Gauntlet
records.description: Hellscream's forces have recently grown scarce along the Orunai Coast. Now the Horde dares to use it as drop-off point for cargo.

records.name: Razorfin Grin
records.description: Take out that enemy supply ship, but act quickly if anyone goes overboard. The orcs don't call it Frostbite Deep for nothing.

records.name: The Lernaean Shore
records.description: Procuring quality leather can be tedious, but the Horde plans to shell the hydras here and skin them. Exhausting work. Perfect setup for a lucrative win.

records.name: Death Metal
records.description: Shipments for Wor'gol must first pass through the Pale Cove's treacherous currents and jagged rocks. That will be the perfect time for us to strike.

records.name: It's All the Rage
records.description: Orcish cloth armor is just as soft and comfortable as ours. Tell your magi they will seize and wear this cargo. No exceptions, gnomes. Make it work.

records.name: Finders, Keepers
records.description: A Horde warrior bound for Frostfire Ridge clumsily dropped a magic necklace overboard. Put him and his vessel out of their misery.

records.name: [ph]
records.description: [ph]

records.name: It's a Boat, It's a Plane, It's... Just a Riverbeast.
records.description: The Iron Horde swooped in when they identified a rogue submarine closing in on their stronghold.  Unfortunately for them, it was just a riverbeast.

records.name: The Wave Mistress
records.description: The deep waters of Draenor's oceans have seen many deaths and precious little peace. This ship and its crew are doomed to wander the seas for eternity.

records.name: On the Rocks
records.description: This ghost ship lies in wait, attacking unwary sailors who approach the treacherous shoals off Gorgrond's eastern coast.

records.name: Blood, Gold, and Regret
records.description: Seizing a fortune proved this destroyer's undoing. Its crew turned on each other, only to become cursed ghosts, unable to spend the gold they gave their lives for.

records.name: Orphaned Aquatic Animal Rescue
records.description: A young shark has been abandoned in a storm off the coast of Nagrand.  Defend it from the Iron Horde and it will likely follow you home.

records.name: Gold in Their Holds
records.description: Uncharted waters proved deadly to these sailors, who still roam the area as murderous ghosts. That said, they were well paid before their deaths.

records.name: Unafraid of Ghosts
records.description: On the one hand, great riches. On the other hand, furious walking corpses. Oh, come now. We all know what choice you're going to make.

records.name: Nothing Gold Can Stay
records.description: Sabotaged by spies, these carriers sank on their way to battle. Denied a glorious death in battle, their ghostly crews sink other ships out of bitterness.

records.name: How to Pierce Thick Armor
records.description: The hulls of destroyers are so thick, it's impossible to pierce it with normal ammunition.  We've crafted battleships with the sole purpose of penetrating destroyer armor.

records.name: Transport Escort
records.description: Transport ships are required to deliver troops to battle or to load up valuable cargo.  Take a transport on this training mission and ensure it reaches its destination intact.

records.name: Sneaking.  Sea Style.
records.description: We designed submarines specifically to sneak up on unsuspecting carriers.  We've set up a carrier in the bay. See if you can sneak up on it.

records.name: Bomber Target Practice
records.description: The best way to take out battleships is by air.  Take a carrier out and have your ace bomber pilots put some holes into it.

records.name: Fine Tuning Depth Charges
records.description: We've set up submarines at different depths off the coast of Shadowmoon Valley.  Take a destroyer out and train them in the art of sub hunting.

records.name: Bomber Target Practice
records.description: The best way to take out battleships is by air.  Take a carrier out and have your ace bomber pilots put some holes into it.

records.name: Stalking the Master
records.description: Capture Ironfist Harbor and interrogate prisoners as to the whereabouts of Gul'dan's flagship.

records.name: Giving Chase
records.description: Captured prisoners indicated that Gul'dan's flagship was last seen in this area of dangerous shoals.

records.name: Test Mission Anders
records.description: Should give you a huge success chance boost, if it's the first mission of the day. Also should give you a cool item!

records.name: A Little Combat
records.description: A Horde sub has been spotted spying around our base.  Take your new destroyer out and end it.

records.name: A Supply Pickup
records.description: Our forward outpost has additional blueprints drafted up and a prototype ship.  Take the transport out and load up the shipment.

records.name: A Little Combat
records.description: An Alliance sub has been spotted spying around our base.  Take your new destroyer out and end it.

records.name: A Supply Pickup
records.description: Our forward outpost has additional blueprints drafted up and a prototype ship.  Take the transport out and load up the shipment.

records.name: Test Communication
records.description: [ph]

records.name: High and Low
records.description: [ph]

records.name: Hotter Than Fel
records.description: Countless munitions are created in Blackrock Foundry, then infused with fel energies in Hellfire Citadel. It's vital that we intercept or destroy whatever we can.

records.name: All Fel Breaks Loose
records.description: Keeping the Iron Reaver in good repair is a full-time job, and it requires a steady supply of parts from Blackrock Foundry. Disrupt that supply.

records.name: War Is Fel
records.description: Blackrock Foundry regularly ships newly forged cannons to Tanaan, where they bolster Hellfire Citadel's defenses. Every ship we sink saves thousands of lives.

records.name: Hunting the Pillars
records.description: There is someone out here who knows about the Pillars of Creation. We must find them.

records.name: Brothers in Arms
records.description: We need the most fearless Illidari to join our cause if we are to have any chance of defeating the Legion.

records.name: Black Market Journal
records.description: A waterlogged crate has washed up on shore.  Break through the Iron Horde and pick it up.

records.name: Finding a Gateway
records.description: If we can find a usable Legion gateway, we can launch an assault on one of their worlds and take it as our own.

records.name: For Hate's Sake
records.description: Vhaka the Vile and her crew once terrorized Draenor's seas, killing and plundering without remorse. Cursed for their evil deeds, they lash out at the living.

records.name: The House Always Wins

records.description: The white-hot cores of the abyssals assaulting Shattrath could be useful as a compressed fuel source, if we can obtain a few.

records.name: Poundface
records.description: Poundface has cornered a small group of our allies bringing oil from the Blackrock Foundry. Help them get the oil back to our garrison.

records.name: Restless Dead

records.name: Not The Bees!
records.description: Our allies in Spires of Arak have requested our aid against a large swarm of ravager wasps threatening their oil-pumping operations.

records.name: Crystal Power
records.description: Deep within Auchindoun, Draenei power crystals still hum with life. We can surely use them as a source of fuel.

records.name: Watery Woes

records.name: Super Slag Siblings
records.description: Two powerful ogres have taken over a portion of the mines containing a shipment of valuable fuel.

records.name: Visions of the Void
records.description: Terrible void creatures are coming from a deep chasm in the burial grounds. There may be other valuables down there as well.

records.name: Eye of the Beast
records.description: A master of beasts has been seen escorting a shipment of oil to Blackrock Mountain. Stop him!

records.name: Every Rose
records.description: A group of podlings has been spotted near some recently-formed tar pits in Gorgrond. If we defeat them, we can extract the fuel.

records.name: Foul Feeders
records.description: The corrupting blood in Spires of Arak has turned the carrion-consuming species into undead monstrosities.

records.name: Resources at the Ridge
records.description: A decrepit ogre caravan was spotted in Frostfire, surrounded by hostile wildlife. It looks like they were hauling oil.

records.name: Vile Bloods
records.description: The void's effect on Draenor has become more pronounced. Vile bloods of the land are emerging.

records.name: Death's Bite Again?
records.description: A powerful spider named Death's Bite has returned as an undead, and terrorizes Talador yet again.

records.name: Fiery Friends
records.description: A group of tiny fiery puppies was spotted deep within Blackrock Foundry. If we save them, we may be able to raise them.

records.name: Breaker Two
records.description: Two enormous breakers have been spotted out on Gorgrond. What better way to test our might?

records.name: Burning Blademasters
records.description: A group of burning blademaster spirits has been roused by the activities in Nagrand. We should investigate.

records.name: Arakkoa Ancestry
records.description: Some ancient artifacts containing untold knowledge are being jealously guarded by arakkoa out in Spires of Arak.

records.name: Ogrecoming Adversity
records.description: The ogres found a huge supply cache out in Frostfire Ridge. Who's up for some ogre hunting?

records.name: Blizzard Convention
records.description: A group of frost furies has gathered in the snowy wastes of Frostfire Ridge and laid waste to a caravan carrying valuable weaponry.

records.name: Eldritch Horrors
records.description: Rumors abound of terrible demons near Shattrath that could drive a follower insane by just looking at them.

records.name: Monstrous Menagerie
records.description: Tanaan Jungle is a harsh landscape, home to some of the most powerful beasts on this world.

records.name: The Consuming Void
records.description: A deep chasm, filled with blackness, was found deep within the burial grounds. Who knows what horrors await us there?

records.name: The Botani Stirr
records.description: The botani of Shadowmoon have regrown, stonger than ever. Let us show them our might and test ourselves in the process.

records.name: Boarding the Master's Call
records.description: You've run Gul'dan's flagship aground, but now all her guns are trained toward the sea. Prepare for the worst.

records.name: Reconnaissance: Azsuna
records.description: Azsuna appears to be an idyllic island teeming with wildlife. Reports of magical activity in the area, however, suggest that not all is as it sems.

records.name: Reconnaissance: Val'Sharah
records.description: Val'Sharah once stood as the heart of druidism on Azeroth, the mighty world tree Shaladrassil standing tall at its center. There are sure to be long-lost secrets hidden in its thickets that would be useful against the Legion.

records.name: Reconnaissance: Highmountain
records.description: Highmountain is all that stands of the range that once divided Suramar from the northern lands. Rumor has it that the leader of an ancient tauren tribe on the lonely mountain's slopes wields a relic of legendary power.

records.name: Reconnaissance: Stormheim
records.description: Once grazing land for the beasts of the Suramar elves, the bluffs of Stormheim now serve as the capital of an ancient race of Vrykul that fled the northern lands after the Great Sundering.

records.name: Never Leave a Knight Behind
records.description: Our scouts report seeing a knight trapped by a horde of demons. Destroy the demons and bring our brother in arms home.

records.name: The Creeping Nightmare
records.description: The forces of Nightmare are closing in on a sacred moonwell. We can't let it fall into darkness.

records.name: Calling Their Bluff
records.description: A Fel Lord may be building up forces in the harsh northern bluffs.

records.name: Coastal Treasure
records.description: There is a powerful beacon of the Light somewhere in Stormheim. We should find it.

records.name: Tides of War
records.description: The Legion is planning to launch a coastal assault on Stormheim. We need to find out where.

records.name: The "Emissary"
records.description: We've heard whispers that a demon has been offering the Highmountain tauren dark power.

records.name: The Last Shrine
records.description: There is a powerful beacon of the Light somewhere in Highmountain. We should find it.

records.name: Protecting the Innocent
records.description: A captured imp told us his masters were planning to attack a Highmountain tauren village - we need to figure out which one.

records.description: We can go after the heavy hitters later, right now we need someone who has seen everything. There is one that has been in every war for the past few decades and can do more than kill.

records.name: Growing the Order
records.description: The only way to strengthen our order is through continued focus and training. There is an ancient master who may be willing to share his martial secrets. Seek him out and train with him, and return stronger and wiser.

records.name: A Master Summoner
records.description: We will need to recruit a master summoner to assist the Council. A warlock of a notable family was rumored to be spotted in Dalaran.

records.name: An Offer They Can't Refuse

records.description: The Naga have secrets, seek them out.

records.description: Harpies in the Haglands have started raiding our nearby camps for supplies.

records.description: The murlocs have made a foothold in the wrecks at Shipwreck Cove.  Clear them out.

records.name: Tracking the Tideskorn: The Gates of Valor
records.description: We've tracked the Tideskorn to a large, fortified camp at the Gates of Valor. Find any information we can about the kidnapped prisoners.

records.name: Tracking the Tideskorn: Storm Drakes
records.description: Drakes have beset our scouts from the skies. These fearsome dragons are looking for their next meal. Let's try not to be dinner!

records.description: We made camp at the base of the mountain, but the area is home to hostile ettin. We'll need to fend them off before we make our ascent.

records.name: Freya's Spring: Snowblind Mesa
records.description: The tauren at Snowblind Mesa are dealing with encroaching drogbar. They've asked for our aid in exchange for shelter.

records.name: Freya's Spring: The Mountain King
records.description: We are nearing Freya's Spring, but the area is guarded by a drogbar chieftain who calls himself the mountain king. Defeat him and we will gain our prize!

records.name: Sampling the Nightmare
records.description: A strange magic seeps from beneath the roots of the world tree, Shaladrassil. We must send our champions to investigate this disturbance.

records.name: The Mysterious Manascale
records.description: The hides of the Manascale Basilisks in Suramar hold some... interesting properties.  Recover some for research.

records.name: Born of the Night
records.description: The Nightbornes infiltrations have gone on too long.  Stop them at all costs.

records.name: An End to the Felsoul
records.description: Yet still more demons flood the depths of Suramar.  We must hold them.

records.name: Tianji Needs Help
records.description: The Order of the Broken Temple is established, but we need more. Tianji, a renowned troop trainer in the Ox Style, just sent word that she has been attacked!

records.description: This high on the mountain, the elements themselves are our greatest enemy. Elementals of wind and ice roam the peaks. Defeat them and press on!

records.name: The Fel Pits
records.description: We have lost an important set of missives in the Fel Pits of Faronaar.  Retrieve them.

records.name: Higher Learning
records.description: The academy at Narthalas once held a great library with a wealth of knowledge.  See if you can find it.

records.name: Fel Bombardment
records.description: The enemy has established an array of casters and are bombarding us with terrible balls of Fel energy.  We need help to counter these attacks!

records.description: Use to max level followers

records.name: Information at Any Cost
records.description: The Burning Legion's minions might have information about where the missing council members are being held. It must be obtained at any cost.

records.name: The Harpies' Curse
records.description: Harpies are spreading their foul curse throughout Highmountain. Death is the only way to ensure the curse won't continue.

records.name: Bradensbrook Under Attack
records.description: Black Rook Assassins are attacking Bradensbrook, killing livestock and stealing crops. Defend the village from these ruthless attackers.

records.name: Cleansing the Vale
records.description: Nightmare imps have taken over Moonclaw Vale, corrupting the once serene glade. Help restore balance by ridding the area of imps.

records.name: Pesky Pest Problem
records.description: Dalaran's underbelly has a bit of a rodent problem. Exterminate the pests before they make their way out of the sewers.

records.name: Hunting the Hunters
records.description: A group of poachers are threatening the wildlife in Highmountain. Show them what it's like to be hunted!

records.name: Unseen Protection: Defending Dalaran
records.description: Archmage Khadgar is concerned for the safety of Dalaran's citizens. He's asked the Unseen Path to provide protection for the city, discreetly.

records.name: Unseen Protection: The Mother of Imps
records.description: An imp mother has made Bradensbrook her breeding grounds, birthing countless imps into the nearby fields. Defeat the imp mother before her brood grows.

records.name: Unseen Protection: Infernal Waves
records.description: A wave of infernals have crashed upon the shores of Suramar. They must be stopped before they march inland.

records.name: Unseen Protection: Coastal Invasion
records.description: The Legion has launched an invasion on the eastern coast of Stormheim. Our hunters can attack at range from the cliffs, protecting the infantry below.

records.name: Unseen Protection: Drogbar Delicacy
records.description: A clan of cave-dwelling drogbar are pilfering eagle eggs to feed to their fledgling worms. They must be stopped before the great eagle becomes extinct!

records.name: Searching the Archives
records.description: The Black Harvest archives contain a vast amount of magical knowledge collected over time. It's possible that within its walls we will find something.

records.name: Shinfel's Staff of Torment
records.description: The staff Shinfel used in battle against Cho'gall would be powerful enough to create the soul link, but first we'll need to find it.

records.name: One Who's Worthy
records.description: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout the city of Dalaran, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.

records.name: Fel Smell
records.description: Theres a foul smell in the air.

records.name: Cleanse the Wicked
records.description: The enemies are continually encroaching on Azsuna.  Seek them out, and destroy them.

records.name: Hazardous Roads
records.description: We must find our way into Faronaar, but the roads are covered in demons.  Let us see if we can scout out an alternate route.

records.name: Mind Your Ears
records.description: Theres a Deathscreamer up in the mountains thats keeping us up at night.  Can you help out?

records.name: Meat for the troops
records.description: The troops are in need of a feast to reward them for their efforts.  Lets get some Goat on the menu.

records.description: The Earthen Ring must send representatives to Skywall to negotiate with the elementals of air. Since the death of Al'Akir, Skywall has been in turmoil.

records.description: There are rumors of a new threat in Deepholm and Therazane has not been present in negotiations with the Elemental Lords. We should investigate.

records.description: The death of Ragnaros has left the Firelands in chaos. Uniting the elemental plane of fire to our cause will not be easy. We should send an envoy.

records.name: Gathering the Dreamweavers: Celestine of the Harvest
records.description: The Temple of Elune is beset by satyr and the minions of the Legion. Celestine of the Harvest is helping, but we will need her here.

records.name: Gathering the Dreamweavers: Thisalee Crow
records.description: Thisalee Crow is in over her head. Sea giants have captured her, and she is being forced to battle in their underground fighting ring. We need to get her out!

records.name: Gathering the Dreamweavers: Matoclaw
records.description: Matoclaw led a team of druids into Highmountain to deal with harpies, but she's been cornered. Defeat Nest Matron Subonn and bring Matoclaw back!

records.name: Gathering the Dreamweavers: Talza
records.description: We haven't heard from Talza and his scouts in Stormheim. Considering the hostile vrykul in that area, it's likely they've been waylaid.

records.name: Powering the Portal: Azsuna
records.description: Satyr warbands have been spotted near the northern shores of Azsuna. They are using Shards of Nightmare to expand Xavius's influence.

records.name: Powering the Portal: Val'sharah
records.description: Shala'nir, the druid grove at the base of the world tree, has been overrun by the satyr and their leader, Banehoof. Send our champions to kill Banehoof.

records.name: Powering the Portal: Sylvan Falls
records.description: We've received a call for aid from the tauren tribes who live along the Sylvan Falls. Satyr scouting camps have begun raiding their villages.

records.name: Ancient Magic
records.description: The Broken Isles harbor many arcane secrets. We should send out our mages and discover as many as we can!

records.name: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: The Nightborne Vault
records.description: The Nightborne Vault is located deep within the Legion incursion area of Suramar. If Archmage Vargoth has been there, we should find signs of him.

records.name: Sister Lilith
records.description: The Dreamgrove is established, but we are going to need help. Sister Lilith, a renowned troop trainer, sent word that she is en route but has been attacked!

records.name: A Glade Defense
records.description: Sundersong Glade is under attack by the Legion's forces. This is a perfect opportunity to test our new troops in the field, and to unlock vital knowledge.

records.name: Captain Stahlstrom
records.description: Odyn has chosen you to command his armies, but we are going to need to train a combat-ready force. Send Ragnvald to find the greatest vrykul captain.

records.name: Troops in the Field
records.description: Now that we have recruited some troops, we can use them to bolster our efforts. This will allow us to free a prisoner held at a village loyal to Helya.

records.name: Troops in Training

records.name: Lenara Needs Help

records.name: Troops in the Field
records.description: Now that we've recruited some troops, it's time to put them in the field. Hostile Feltotem have been kidnapping our allies, and need to be taught a lesson.

records.name: Scouting Reports
records.description: Our scouts in the field will have the information we need to help determine where to focus our efforts. We need to gather their reports.

records.name: Requesting Reinforcements
records.description: We need reinforcements in order to defeat Hakkar! Most have answered our call, but Shandris Feathermoon remains mired in battle with the naga. Help her, so she will help us in return.

records.name: Things Gaardoun Needs
records.description: To train new broken warriors how to deal with the new Burning Legion, Battlelord Gaardoun is requesting that you gather demonic implements.
